caption: The drawing is on a plain, off-white or light beige background. It consists of three primary outlined shapes, each resembling a segment of a dress or garment sewing pattern. These shapes are labeled with annotations such as "A-1 (1)", "A-1 (2)", and "A-2 (2)", and have additional small markings, arrows, and text, such as "FRENTE E" and "SEAM." The shapes feature curves and angles that suggest sections for sleeves, necklines, and armholes. Below these main shapes, there is a small drawing labeled "C" depicting a floral or rosette-like design with ribbon-like extensions. The entire composition is drawn in fine, light gray or pencil lines and is set within a rectangular border. There are no colors besides the base paper and the pencil lines. Above the rectangular border, at the top left, there is faint cursive handwriting.
title: Coat (Pattern)
